title: Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

reports.title: Parkview High receives 4th AI-generated bomb threat this year
Hoax phone call at Gwinnett high school causes lockdown; campus cleared
Masked AI call forces Parkview High into soft lockdown

summary:
Parkview High School in Gwinnett County, Georgia received its fourth bomb threat of the school year on Monday. The threat was generated using artificial intelligence and came from a masked phone number. School officials placed the campus on lockdown as a precaution, then later returned to normal operations.

Gwinnett County school police are investigating with the Georgia Bureau of Investigation and the FBI. No suspect has been identified and no arrests have been announced. The latest incident follows a pattern seen in recent threats involving masked phone numbers. Authorities are continuing to work to determine who is responsible for the repeated threats.
